The sequence of rolls shown is

\[
\text{right},\ \text{right},\ \text{up},\ \text{right},\ \text{up},\ \text{right}.
\]

Label the die’s original faces \(D,U,E,W,N,S\), according to their initial bottom, top, east, west, north, and south positions.

- Rolling right makes the current east face the new bottom.
- Rolling up makes the current south face the new bottom.

Tracking the faces gives:

\[
\begin{array}{c|c}
\text{Position} & \text{Original face on bottom}\\ \hline
1&D\\
2&E\\
3&U\\
4&S\\
5&W\\
6&D\\
7&N
\end{array}
\]

Thus, the face originally on the bottom returns to the bottom at position \(6\), so it occupied positions \(1\) and \(6\).
